overall_summary: Data shows clear outlier performance for husband-wife/marital relationship dynamics (1,770 and 1,678 views) compared to generic shayari or other family topics which struggled or averaged below 400 views. Emotional real-life relationship dilemmas heavily outperform poetry.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,770 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,678 views) generated massive relative engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on marriage, unspoken marital expectations, and everyday relationship friction.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framing a common internal debate or hidden realization perform significantly better than third-person sad poetry.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 21 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract, overly dramatic poetry; ground the content in everyday realistic observations.

weak_patterns.evidence: Certain sister/brother emotional shorts underperformed relative to the core relationship hits.
weak_patterns.action: Limit pure family nostalgia unless tied directly to modern domestic friction.
